subject: Acme MAP: Post-call recap & mutual action plan
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Sara Lopez <sara.lopez@acme.com>, Tom Nguyen <tom.nguyen@acme.com>
Cc: Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 12 Oct 2027 15:10:00 -0700
Subject: Acme MAP: Post-call recap & mutual action plan

Hi Sara / Tom - 

Thanks again for taking the time earlier today. Quick recap from our discovery call and a proposed mutual action plan (MAP) attached. High-level takeaways: 

- Pain points: slow inference latency on customer-facing search (avg 1.8s p95), high per-token cost on current pipeline, and unpredictable tail latency during peak hours.
- Goals: reduce p95 latency to <800ms for the search flow, cut per-token inference cost by ~30% through batching/caching, and deploy in production with an SLA by end of Q1.
- Primary success metrics: 95th percentile latency, cost per 1M tokens, error rate on edge cases (measured via our evals).

Key stakeholders you called out:
- Sara Lopez (Search Product Lead) - product/requirements owner
- Tom Nguyen (Engineering Manager) - technical decision-maker and integration owner
- Procurement (procurement@acme.com) - purchasing/contract

Proposed MAP milestones (attached as spreadsheet + pasted below):
1) Technical review & POC plan (Scope doc & infra checklist) - target: Oct 20 - owner: Tom
2) POC execution (3-week POC on staging with monitoring) - target: Nov 10 - owner: Redwood (Marissa/Camila) + Acme Eng
3) Performance tuning & quantization recommendations - target: Nov 24 - owner: Redwood Research
4) Contract & procurement - target: Dec 8 - owner: Acme Procurement
5) Production rollout (canary + full rollout) - target: Jan 31 - owner: Acme Eng + Redwood Ops

Next steps: 
- Please confirm the proposed dates and owners (I penciled Tom for the technical review).
- Tom - can you share a staging endpoint we can use for the POC and any IP/sec constraints?
- Sara - confirm procurement contact (I used procurement@acme.com as placeholder).

Attachments: mutual-action-plan-acme.xlsx, acme-poc-scope.pdf

Best,
Marissa Cole
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.com | (415) 555-0187

Hi Marissa - 

Thanks for the clear recap and the MAP - this aligns with what we discussed. A few notes and confirmations from our side: 

- Confirmed pain/goals: yes to all three (latency, cost, reliability).
- Procurement contact is procurement@acme.com (please loop them in on contract-related docs).
- Decision process: Product + Eng evaluate the POC, then Procurement reviews commercial/terms. Final approval by VP of Product (Maya Chen). Target decision date: Dec 10.

Tom - can you confirm the staging details? We have a cluster we can open to Redwood engineers; I'll coordinate with Tom on IP allowlist.

A few clarifications on the MAP dates: Oct 20 for tech review is fine, Nov 10 POC end looks tight - happy to extend to Nov 17 if Redwood recommends.

I'm attaching our internal security checklist (lightly redacted).

Thanks - Sara
